thread.title: Star Trek Celebrates 60 Years with Fluxx Card Game Relaunch

author: screenrant
title: Star Trek Celebrates 60 Years with Fluxx Card Game Relaunch
text:
In 2026, the legendary Star Trek franchise reaches its 60th anniversary, prompting Looney Labs to re‑release the original Star Trek Fluxx board game and all four classic standalone versions. The movement also introduces the new Star Trek: Lower Decks Fluxx edition, giving fans a chance to play through five distinct eras of the franchise. Each game comes with fresh components and nostalgic references, letting players command the Enterprise and face iconic adversaries while enjoying the unpredictable rules and changing goals that define Fluxx. The relaunch highlights the cultural impact of the original series and marks a milestone for both the franchise and its tabletop gaming community.
2026 marks a historic milestone for Star Trek, as the franchise celebrates 60 years since the original series premiered in 1966. What began as a short‑lived science‑fiction broadcast turned into one of the most influential television franchises of all time, expanding across television reruns, feature films, books, games, and countless other media.
Famous for the leadership of William Shatner as Captain James T. Kirk, Leonard Nimoy as Spock, and DeForest Kelley as Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy, the original show introduced audiences to the USS Enterprise and its mission to explore strange new worlds while addressing social issues that were ahead of its time. Although only three seasons were filmed, the show's syndication popularity yielded a lasting cultural legacy, inspiring countless spin‑offs, movies, and tie‑in media that have persisted through the decades.
Now, more than six decades later, Star Trek fans have an opportunity to honor that legacy in a novel way: Looney Labs has re‑introduced the Star Trek Fluxx card game to the market. Initially sold in 2018, the game fell out of print, but the company has seized the opportunity to launch a limited reprint of all four of its original standalone Fluxx titles - Original Series, The Next Generation, Deep Space Nine, and Voyager - beginning October 20, 2026.
The relaunch is timed to coincide with the launch of the brand‑new Star Trek: Lower Decks Fluxx edition, effectively giving collectors and players versions covering five distinct eras of the franchise. The returning Original Series edition is priced at $25 and features a simple, flexible rule set. Players begin the game by drawing one card and playing one card.
As the match progresses, new Rule cards placed into play modify the number of cards a player may draw, play, or keep, while new Goal cards alter the victory condition. This ever‑shifting framework ensures that each game feels fresh and unpredictable. The deck also includes classic Star Trek references, such as cards that invoke the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Star Empire, and even the Doomsday Machine, as well as classic moments like Fizzbin and Venting the Warp Core.
Players gather Keeper cards to satisfy the current Goal and claim victory. The relaunch is not simply a commercial move; it is a celebratory homage to a franchise that has shaped science‑fiction storytelling for more than half a century. By reviving the original game and introducing a new iteration that covers a younger, cartoon‑style series, Looney Labs offers a way for fans to experience the breadth of Star Trek history in a multiplayer format.
Whether played with family or friends, the Fluxx games provide a playful tribute to the enduring optimism, curiosity, and humanity that launched from the small studio set of the 1960s and continue to inspire new generations. At the same time, the re‑print will likely attract collectors seeking to complete a timeless set, just as the franchise itself has amassed a massive audience eager to participate in its 60th anniversary celebrations.
The initiative demonstrates how a nostalgic medium like a card game can serve as a bridge between different eras of storytelling. By highlighting key moments from the Original Series and extended to newer shows such as Lower Decks, the release reinforces the unified universe and the bond that Star Trek has built over time. As 2026 unfolds, fans worldwide will be able to experience a dynamic, interactive homage to the voice of one of television's most iconic communities.
This relaunch culminates in a comprehensive celebration of Star Trek's impact on popular culture, offering the gaming community a tangible way to honor the franchise's past while enjoying a modern, engaging experience
